queryDefinition.dedupRule: Items are grouped by acquisition key = (s2:datatake_id with the trailing processing-baseline suffix removed, MGRS tile). Within a group the canonical item is the one with the highest s2:processing_baseline, then the latest s2:generation_time, then item id. All variants are retained.

cloudMetricNote: tileCloudCoverPct is eo:cloud_cover for the whole ~110 km MGRS tile, NOT cloud over the project polygons. Do not use it to judge scene suitability for the project area.
